listings.name: league-lean — meta tier list + auto rune/build apply + post-game op.gg, all in one sidebar
listings.description: Hey guys 👋 Sharing something I've been building the past few days. The League client has bothered me forever — heavy on my PC, and I really don't like having to tab out to Porofessor / op.gg / lolalytics every time I pick a champion. I wanted everything in the client, lean, no extra windows. So I built it. league-lean is meant to replace the external sites you usually open during the loading screen. The meta lives directly in a sidebar. ⚙ How the plugin works A small button bottom-right opens a sidebar with three tabs: Champion tab (auto-focuses when you lock in) — champion tier (S+ → D), winrate / pickrate / banrate, two rune-page variants side-by-side (most-played AND highest-winrate, each with its own apply button), strong-vs / weak-vs matchups, deeplinks to lolalytics / u.gg / metasrc / mobalytics / op.gg / probuilds. Meta tab — full tier list per lane (top / jg / mid / adc / sup), with a search bar. The ★ stars sync with Riot's actual preferred-picks (the heart system used for autofill protection), so toggling here updates Riot's collection page and vice versa. Click any row to drill into that champion. Settings tab — toggles for everything, plus an in-app updater. Other features: • Auto lock-in when your pick action fires • Auto-apply runes matching your locked champ (most-played or highest-WR, configurable) • Auto-apply item build as a custom in-game shop set • Auto-accept queue • Post-game overlay — all 10 players with op.gg buttons + a match-history viewer for the last 20 games • Performance mode + clean-up of Loot / Clubs / Events / news widget 📦 Dependencies - Pengu Loader ≥ 1.1.0 - Windows 10/11 (macOS works via [pengu-mac](), experimental) - No other plugins required 🔧 How to install 1. In the Pengu UI → Open plugins folder 2. Download [install-league-lean.bat]() into that folder 3. Double-click it 4. Quit the League client and relaunch via Riot Client That's it. Future updates → Settings → "Update now & reload" inside the client. No script re-running, no manual file copying. GitHub (full README, source, issues): < 📷 Media See Github or the posts here. 💬 Feedback It's not finished — already planning item-build display in the Champion tab, sortable Meta columns, patch-trend deltas. Genuinely want feedback though, especially on what's broken or missing. DMs open — I'm down to work on requested features. Not endorsed by Riot Games. Uses the unsupported LCU API; Korean accounts excluded per Riot policy. - obviously.

listings.name: Spotify Controller - In-game playback controls
listings.description: Spotify Controller – In-game playback controls Hi everyone, I’m excited to share a new plugin for Pengu Loader: Spotify Controller. This plugin allows you to manage your music directly from the League of Legends client without ever having to Alt-Tab. Features: Integrated UI: Access play/pause, skip, and volume controls via a sleek sidebar. Now Playing: Real-time display of track titles, artists, and album art. Auto-Sync: Seamlessly syncs with your active Spotify session. Secure Auth: Uses a local Node.js server to handle authentication safely via your own Spotify Developer credentials. Requirements: Node.js installed on your PC. A Spotify Developer account (free) to generate your own Client ID. How to install: 1. Clone the repository and follow the README.md to setup your .env file. 2. Run node server.js in the background. 3. Install the plugin in your Pengu Loader directory. You can find the full installation guide and the source code here: < And also the visual : < Feedback and bug reports are welcome! Enjoy your climb with the perfect soundtrack. PS : I know the setup is a bit of a headache just to skip some songs lol, but it's the only way to keep the connection secure and stable!

listings.name: 🩺 Mayhem Doctor
listings.description: ARAM Mayhem analyst, built right into the client. Digs through your match history (10-400 games or more) and breaks down exactly how you're performing: win rates by champion, augment combos, item build paths, full match scoreboards, and more. Everything runs locally inside your client: which means Mayhem Doctor can actually show you your full Mayhem history, something sites like OP.GG and U.GG can't do properly because Riot doesn't give them access to Mayhem game data through their public API. What's inside - General Stats champions, augments, items overview with sortable tables - Match History every game, click any row for the full 10-player scoreboard - Specific Champions per-champ deep dive: best augment builds, item paths, win rates - Patch Filter filter all stats by patch, preference saved between sessions - Investigator Mode enter any Riot ID and pull the same breakdown for them Hotkeys & UI placements Alt + X open from anywhere in the client Ctrl + K → search Mayhem Doctor or ARAM via Command Bar Match History page Mayhem! button Profile pages Mayhem Investigator sub-tab Install [Tested on Pengu Loader V1.1.6] 1. Open Plugins Folder → drop in the mayhem-doctor folder 2. Relaunch your client ➡️ V1.1.0 [Release]() — [GitHub]()
